summary: Psyence Biomedical (Toronto-listed, US SEC foreign private issuer) filed a 6-K disclosing a financing and related-party restructuring at affiliate Psyence Labs Ltd. PsyLabs is issuing up to 2,138 new shares for up to US$5,481,832, or US$2,564 per share, on a US$54,000,000 pre-money valuation. Affiliate Psyence Biomed II Corp. holds a 620-share initial pro-rata entitlement worth US$1,589,680 and has backstopped the remainder across two milestone subscription rounds; the parties also executed a value-matched share-for-share swap and will form Texas Ibogaine Research Corporation for a potential US clinical trial. Watch for milestone funding conditions, dilution from backstop shares, related-party pricing, and trial-timing catalysts.
